This plot is rented, so I am careful about spending too much on it — the landlord takes his share and I do not own the land. The crop here is not my main teff or maize, just something extra, so I will not buy expensive fertilizer for it. I will put some manure from our animals and use seed I saved myself. My husband and I will do most of the work; maybe I call one neighbor for a day or two at weeding time.
